settings.question: What is your shipping policy?
settings.answer: We offer complimentary worldwide express shipping on all orders over $150. Orders are processed within 24 business hours.

settings.question: What is your return & exchange policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be in original unworn condition with tags attached.

settings.question: Are your products covered by a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes, all items include a 2-year warranty against manufacturing flaws and material defects.
